environment.description: Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh. The WebSocket service runs in namespace 'frontend-services' with automatic sidecar injection. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy is applied to the 'data-layer' namespace with a DENY rule for traffic originating from principals not matching 'cluster.local/ns/data-layer/sa/*'. Additionally, a PeerAuthentication resource in 'data-layer' namespace enforces STRICT mTLS mode. The database service 'db-svc' in 'data-layer' namespace only has a ServiceEntry allowing connections from service accounts within its own namespace. Note: the WebSocket upgrade itself is handled at the Envoy level in 'frontend-services' and the AuthorizationPolicy on 'frontend-services' namespace allows inbound WebSocket connections from the ingress gateway - the restriction is specifically on the egress path from 'frontend-services' to 'data-layer' for TCP port 5432.

config.service_mesh_policy: All cross-namespace traffic to port 5432 in data-layer is denied at the Envoy proxy level before reaching the application container
